QuestionStmt.S: The number of lines of force originating from a point charge of $2 \times 8.85 \times 10^{-9}$ C in a medium of dielectric constant 10 is ($\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}$ SI unit)

Solution.S:
Number of electric lines of force originating from a charge $q$ in a medium is given by: $N = \frac{q}{\varepsilon_0 K}$.

Given: $q = 2 \times 8.85 \times 10^{-9}$ C, $K = 10$, $\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}$.

$$N = \frac{2 \times 8.85 \times 10^{-9}}{8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times 10} = \frac{2 \times 10^{-9}}{10^{-12} \times 10} = \frac{2 \times 10^{-9}}{10^{-11}} = 2 \times 10^{2} = 200$$

Final Answer: $$\boxed{200}$$

Hence, the correct option is B.
